description: Tests for pipeline intelligence features (auto-tagging, form extraction, citation detection) and integration tests for the document intelligence services.
steps: 1. Create tests/test_auto_tagger.py: Test the auto_tagger service. Mock the LLM call (patch app.core.llm.chat_completion) to return known tag names. Verify tags are parsed correctly from LLM response.
2. Create tests/test_form_extractor.py: Test the form_extractor service. Mock LLM to return JSON key-value pairs. Test with default prompt and with custom template prompt.
3. Create tests/test_citation_detector.py: Test the citation_detector service. Mock LLM to return document IDs. Test it correctly maps references.

4. Update tests/test_pipeline.py if needed: Ensure existing pipeline tests still pass with the new steps. The new steps use LLM which is already mocked in pipeline tests. Add a test that verifies auto-tagging, form extraction, and citation detection are called during pipeline processing (mock them to ensure they don't break the flow).

5. Create tests/test_expiry_prediction_service.py: Test the expiry prediction logic. Create documents with lifecycle transitions at known timestamps, verify the prediction calculates reasonable averages.
acceptance_criteria: Full test suite passes (all original 620 + new tests)
Tests properly mock LLM calls (no real API calls in tests)
uv run ruff check app/ tests/ passes
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_auto_tagger.py tests/test_form_extractor.py tests/test_citation_detector.py -v
